connection: A fresh sqlite3 connection is opened per request via get_connection() in db.py; raw SQL, no ORM.
queries: Lookup of a single subscriber by email, inserts into the sends table.
transactions: One implicit transaction per request, committed after the send record is inserted.
n_plus_one: None in the original single-subscriber flow.

optimization_targets.description: Add a send_batch_endpoint that selects all subscribed members and sends the campaign to each one in chunks of 50, recording sent/failed status per recipient and tolerating individual SMTP failures.

notes: The new endpoint must fully implement chunking, per-recipient status tracking in the sends table, and error handling so one failed send does not stop the campaign.
